intent: A fat, sunburnt, scruffy man reclines on a wooden beach lounger on a tropical beach, facing the camera, chest up, Hawaiian shirt, sunglasses on his head. START: right hand holds a pineapple cocktail in front of his lower chest, left forearm on the armrest, tired sorry-for-himself look, mouth closed. END: left hand lifted open palm up beside his left shoulder in a whiny shrug, left shoulder raised, head tilted, eyebrows raised, mouth closed; the right hand and the cocktail have not moved. Beach, sea, palms and lounger do not move. The clip will be lip-synced later, so the mouth is closed in both frames. MOTION (about 3.4 s): locked camera; he holds the look, then lifts his free hand palm up beside his shoulder and tilts his head; the cocktail hand stays put. Palm fronds sway and small waves roll. Mouth stays closed (lips are synced afterwards).

person.compare_why: a shrug lifts the shoulders and pulls the shoulder landmarks toward the neck; hips and legs are hidden; head width (ear-to-ear and outer-eye mean) is the size measure a chest-up shrug leaves valid, and the head tilts but does not turn

hands.right: holds the pineapple cocktail in the same place in both frames
hands.left: on the armrest in START, open palm up beside the shoulder in END
